stories.title: Define Weighting Schema and Persistence Contract
stories.description: Define data model for user-specific measure weights including defaults, normalization rules (e.g., sum-to-1 or bounded ranges), and storage schema. Establish contract mapping weights to scoring inputs for both provider and clinical trial scoring engines.
stories.evidence: GAP: No weighting or preference persistence system exists; schema must be created for user-defined weights and mapping to scoring inputs

stories.title: Implement Weighted Scoring Adjustment Logic
stories.description: Build core logic to apply normalized user-defined weights to underlying quality measures and deterministically recalculate composite scores for providers and clinical trials, ensuring compatibility with existing scoring engines.
stories.evidence: Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/backend/application/facades/evaluate_care_facade.py + Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/backend/domain/evaluate_care_quality/clinical_trials_service.py + GAP: no weighting logic currently applied

stories.title: Expose Weight Configuration API and UI Controls
stories.description: Create backend endpoints to save/retrieve user weights and frontend controls (e.g., sliders) to adjust measure importance. Ensure immediate recalculation is triggered on change and UI remains synchronized with persisted backend state.
stories.evidence: Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/frontend/src/components/ChatWindow.tsx + GAP: no existing preference UI or API endpoints

stories.title: Integrate Weighting into Evaluate Care Facade Flow
stories.description: Modify evaluate_care_facade to incorporate user weights into scoring requests and enforce consistent application across provider and clinical trial evaluation paths.

stories.title: Weighting Logic Unit and Integration Test Suite
stories.description: Develop tests validating weight normalization rules, deterministic score recalculation, persistence accuracy, and end-to-end flow from UI input to updated scores, including edge cases (missing weights, extreme values).
